items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: Oh yeah, my parents, I think I didn't hear it, Bill.

ctx.x: Can you tell us anything about the earliest music that you ever heard? Did your parents play anything? Did you hear anything? Oh yeah, my parents, I think I didn't hear it, Bill. But my mother, she played piano until yet she played.
She played organ at the church now. Yeah, the first free-wheel Baptist church, Truro and Claymore. She always did play and had a few great fellas playing piano in my family.
